note: byte5[3] was the missing key bit: min and xor differ in it and in nothing else the old four-bit key looked at, so they collided. Recovered by flipping one bit at a time in the add witness and asking Apple's decoder, then reconstructing all seven operations from that single base - every constructed key equals its own witness's. The device atomic op10018 at length 12 already carried this key. The five keys absent from the table decode as op11766 or not at all.
